title: montia parvifolia subsp. flagellaris
intro: Montia parvifolia subsp. flagellaris, commonly known as the 'creeping chickweed' or 'creeping miner's lettuce', is a flowering plant in the purslane family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Montia parvifolia subsp. flagellaris include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
